name: epistery/message-board
title: Message board
description: Community message board with whitelist and notabot access control
author: Epistery

tools.name: message_channels
tools.description: List available message board channels. Returns channels the caller has access to.

tools.name: message_list
tools.description: List message board posts. Optionally filter by channel. Each post carries a `comments` array — the replies to that post, oldest first, each with its own `id` for message_reply_edit / message_reply_delete. To respond to a post, use message_reply rather than message_post: a new top-level post that merely references another one breaks the thread.

channel.description: Channel name to filter by (e.g. 'general'). Omit for all channels.

tools.name: message_post
tools.description: Start a new thread on the message board. To respond to something already posted, use message_reply instead.

tools.name: message_edit
tools.description: Rewrite one of your own posts. Only the post's author may edit it; moderators delete rather than rewrite. The text is replaced entirely — there is no revision history, so pass the full new body. Cannot move a post between channels.

id.description: Id of the post to edit (from message_list).

text.description: New post content, replacing the old text entirely.

tools.name: message_delete
tools.description: Delete a post and every reply under it. Authors can delete their own; admins can moderate anyone's. This is permanent — the post is removed from storage outright, not tombstoned, and cannot be recovered.

id.description: Id of the post to delete (from message_list).

tools.name: message_reply
tools.description: Reply to an existing post. Replies thread one level deep under the post — this is the right way to respond to something already on the board. Returns the created reply, including the `id` needed to edit or delete it.

id.description: Id of the post being replied to (from message_list).

tools.name: message_reply_edit
tools.description: Rewrite one of your own replies. Only the reply's author may edit it; moderators delete rather than rewrite.

id.description: Id of the post the reply is under.

cid.description: Id of the reply to edit (from the post's `comments` array).

text.description: New reply content, replacing the old text entirely.

tools.name: message_reply_delete
tools.description: Delete a reply. Authors can delete their own; admins can moderate anyone's.

id.description: Id of the post the reply is under.

cid.description: Id of the reply to delete.
